title.narrative: SN - Electricity Sector Efficiency Enhancement - Phase 1, APL-1

description.narrative: The Senegal Electricity Sector Efficiency Enhancement Project aims to: (1) maintain and increase the electricity supply and the reliability of the services; (2) reduce the costs of the electricity services; and (3) enhance the performance of key energy sector institutions. The Project includes two components: Part A focuses on priority activities that will allow the commission for Senegal's National Power Utility (SENELEC) new generation facilities through an independent power producer; rehabilitate critical sections of the transmission and distribution systems; and reduce costs. It also supports the government and SENELEC in preparing the next phase of investment in the energy sector. Part B would provide financial resources to support the government's efforts to strengthen the institutions; implement public/private partnership arrangements for SENELEC; and for communication and monitoring and evaluation of project implementation.

The development objectives of the project are to help the Borrower to: (a) assist in maintaining and increasing the electricitysupply and the reliability and cost-effectiveness of electricity services; and (b) enhance the performance of key institutions ofthe energy sector. The Project includes two main parts: Part A focuses on strengthening SENELEC#s power generation through theinvolvement of the private sector and rehabilitating its transmission and distribution systems. It also supports the governmentand SENELEC in the development of a master plan for electricity generation, transmission and distribution investments. Part Bsupports the government's efforts to strengthen sector institutions, implement public/private partnership arrangements for SENELEC,and monitor and evaluate project implementation.

condition.narrative: Borrower shall conduct an annual review of the Project by Feb. 1 of each year. Borrower shall conduct a mid-term review not laterthan 18 months after credit effectiveness.
Every quarter, & no later than 1 month after the end of each quarter, the PCU will submit to IDA an Activity Report including thefinancial monitoring reports, in form & substance acceptable to IDA
SENELEC shall attain a value for return on assets ratio of not less than 3% for 2006 and at least 5% for 2008
SENELEC shall for each year of Project implementation, maintain a financial leverage ratio of no more than 65%
SENELEC shall maintain a debt service coverage ratio of not less than 1.1 over the 2006-2008 period.
SENELEC shall maintain its net accounts receivable at less than: (i) 105 days of sales at end of year 2006, and (ii) 90 days ofsales at end of year 2007 and at the end of year 2008
SENELEC shall provide IDA with its quarterly accounts, six-month audited accounts, and its end-FY audited accounts
SENELEC shall, not later than 2 months before the end of its FY, transmit to IDA, for comments, its investment program, financingplan and business plan as approved by its Board of Directors
SENELEC to furnish to Assoc. other info re records & accts & audit of financial statements (annual legal audit - Rapports generauxet speciaux des Commissaires aux Comptes)
SENELEC to implement Env. Mangement Plan, and, if applicable, Resettlement Action Plan & coord. w/Kounoune Proj. Sponsors, as & ifneeded, on implementation of these Plans & on env. & soc. frameworks
The PCU and SENELEC shall maintain a financial managment system acceptable to IDA.
